 Can Como FINALLY defeat Inter Milan? | Serie A MATCH PREVIEW - Morning Footy
 It's a top 4 clash in the Serie A as Cesc Fábregas' Como travel to Milan to face Cristian Chivu's Inter. CBS Sports Serie A Analyst Marco Messina join the Morning Footy crew to breakdown the biggest match in the league following Como's massive win over Lens. Plus, a closer look at Inter Milan and if Como is their only threat while looking to repeat as Serie A champions.
